features.name: List Entries
features.description: Opens a ZIP archive and enumerates 1,000 entry names and sizes.

features.name: Find Entry By Name
features.description: Opens a 1,000-entry ZIP archive and locates its final entry by exact name.

features.name: Read Stored Entry
features.description: Opens and reads one uncompressed 4 MiB ZIP entry.

features.name: Decompress Entry
features.description: Opens and inflates one 4 MiB deflated ZIP entry.

features.name: Extract Many Small Entries
features.description: Opens and reads all 1,000 small entries from a ZIP archive.

features.name: Create Stored Archive
features.description: Creates a stored ZIP archive containing a deterministic mixed corpus.

features.name: Create Deflate Fast Archive
features.description: Creates a Deflate level 1 ZIP archive containing the deterministic mixed corpus.

features.name: Create Deflate Optimal Archive
features.description: Creates a Deflate level 6 ZIP archive containing the deterministic mixed corpus.

features.name: Create Many Small Entries
features.description: Creates a stored ZIP archive containing 1,000 small files.

features.name: Append Entry
features.description: Opens an existing ZIP archive for update and appends one stored entry.

features.name: Sequential Non-Seekable Read
features.description: Reads all entries through a forward-only ZIP API from a non-seekable stream.

features.name: Read Zip64 Archive
features.description: Opens and enumerates a Zip64 archive containing 65,536 entries.

features.name: Read AES Encrypted Entry
features.description: Opens and decrypts one AES-256 encrypted ZIP entry.
